title: Tiny, cute popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='ice' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fb1'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff4f7e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d81e5b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stick' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f7d9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c9974f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='12' height='26' rx='4' fill='url(#stick)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='66' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe9c4'/>

  <!-- popsicle body -->
  <rect x='26' y='16' width='48' height='50' rx='16' fill='url(#ice)'/>
  <!-- lighter edge on the right side -->
  <rect x='26' y='16' width='48' height='50' rx='16' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c9' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- gloss highlight -->
  <rect x='33' y='22' width='9' height='22' rx='4.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- drips along the bottom -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='63' r='5' fill='#e8336a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='65' r='6' fill='#e8336a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='62' r='4.5' fill='#e8336a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='63' r='2' fill='#ff9ab6' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='65' r='2.4' fill='#ff9ab6' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='3.4' fill='#3a1030'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='3.4' fill='#3a1030'/>
  <circle cx='41.2' cy='36.9' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='36.9' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M44 46 Q50 51 56 46' fill='none' stroke='#3a1030' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ff9ab6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ff9ab6' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
